name: Demo — WannaCry Global Outbreak
description: Demo scenario inspired by the publicly attributed 2017 WannaCry outbreak. Reconnaissance and propagation context is enriched for matrix coverage, and this is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: Internet Exposure
layers.description: Identify exposed Windows services and vulnerable systems that could provide an initial propagation path.

layers.name: Initial Endpoint
layers.description: Exploit a reachable host, execute the payload, inspect the local environment, and identify files targeted for encryption.

layers.name: Enterprise Network
layers.description: Discover adjacent systems and services, then propagate through remote Windows services and administrative shares.

layers.name: Business Operations
layers.description: Encrypt data, inhibit recovery, stop dependent services, and force system disruption across affected endpoints.
